claims: The Renaissance occurred circa the 14th–16th centuries.
The Renaissance followed the Middle Ages.
The printing press was invented circa 1440.
Rinascita is the original Italian term used by Giorgio Vasari.
Florence is the birthplace of the Renaissance.
The Medici family heavily influenced Florence.
The Early Modern Period is the historical era covering the Renaissance.
Renaissance art and architecture featured artists Leonardo da Vinci, Michelangelo, and Raphael.
Key figures of the Renaissance include Michelangelo, Leonardo da Vinci, Raphael, Machiavelli, and Galileo.
The Renaissance era saw the decline of the feudal system.
The Renaissance era saw the rise of commerce.
